formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P18 — Frozen Hybrid-Reversal Attribution, Training-Scale Learning-Curve Reconstitution, Seed-Variance Decomposition, Fresh48 Composition Reweighting, Raw↔Search Complementarity Localization, P16 Stage-Held-Out↔P17 Untouched-Fresh Ordering Reconciliation & Successor-Freshness Gate Audit

parents.p16_r4_development_ordering: HANDCRAFTED_SEARCH beats HYBRID on all four stage-held-out development cohorts
parents.p17_secondary_ordering: HYBRID beats HANDCRAFTED_SEARCH on untouched fresh48

authority.p17_fresh48: converted to DEVELOPMENT_ONLY after P17 terminal verdict

H_SCALE.statement: HYBRID needs more training solves than HAND because its larger token family has higher estimation burden; full296 exposes complementarity that 200–256-solve stage-held-out fits miss.
H_SCALE.rule: median HYBRID-minus-HAND fresh48 NLL decreases monotonically with scale; n=296 median <0; n=160 minus n=296 >=0.01

H_VARIANCE.statement: The P17 HYBRID win is mainly fit/seed variance.
H_VARIANCE.rule: at n=296, fewer than 3 of 4 controlled seeds have HYBRID-minus-HAND <0 OR sign range spans both <=-0.01 and >=+0.01

H_COMPOSITION.statement: Fresh48 evaluation composition makes HYBRID look better even without a global representation reversal.
H_COMPOSITION.rule: reweighting fresh48 per-solve HYBRID-minus-HAND margins to at least one historical development-stage marginal distribution over method/band/era changes sign or shifts the mean by >=0.01

H_COMPLEMENTARITY.statement: RAW contributes incremental information specifically where HAND is weak.
H_COMPLEMENTARITY.rule: among P17 fresh48 solves, mean HAND-minus-HYBRID is >0 in RAW-better-than-HAND solves and exceeds the same quantity in HAND-better-than-RAW solves by >=0.01

sampling_and_training.scale_selection: deterministic SHA-256 rank within development stage, with proportional stage quotas summing exactly to each frozen scale
sampling_and_training.retraining_scope: development audit only; no model from P18 may be promoted or evaluated on new fresh data without a successor preseal

composition_reweighting.weighting: post-stratify P17 solve-equal margins to each historical stage marginal distribution on one axis at a time; unsupported levels => non-evaluable, never imputed

adjudication.composition_mediated: H_COMPOSITION passes AND H_SCALE fails AND H_VARIANCE fails
adjudication.localized_complementarity_unresolved: H_COMPLEMENTARITY passes but none of the above resolves the reversal

successor_freshness_gate.reopen_only_if: P18 yields one pre-specifiable rival whose success/failure changes representation selection and a new contact-budget audit shows that existing 344 development solves cannot resolve it

inference_boundary: P17 fresh48 is development evidence in P18 because the reversal hypothesis was generated from it.
P18 can explain or fail to explain the reversal; it cannot independently confirm HYBRID.
Predictive representation ordering is not cognitive mechanism identification.
No metadata coordinate receives causal authority from reweighting.
No new body contact is permitted in P18.
